canonical.title: Day trips within 30 km of Les Prés d'Eugénie

parent.title: A weekend at Les Prés d'Eugénie: walk to a 3-star dinner, day-trip the Tursan ring

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Les Prés d'Eugénie
siblings.summary: Every walkable bed in Eugénie-les-Bains, ranked by what makes sense for a Saturday-night dinner at Guérard's 3-star.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Les Prés d'Eugénie
siblings.summary: Eight character properties around Eugénie-les-Bains, from the on-estate convent to Tursan manors and Armagnac estates.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Les Prés d'Eugénie
siblings.summary: A 30 km radius around Les Prés d'Eugénie is a tech-event desert — only Mont-de-Marsan (26 km) hosts anything IT-flavoured.

sources.title: ViaMichelin · Eugénie → Aire-sur-l'Adour
sources.claim: Aire-sur-l'Adour is about 14 km / 16 minutes by car from Eugénie-les-Bains.

sources.title: Tourisme Landes · Église Sainte-Quitterie
sources.claim: Sainte-Quitterie is UNESCO-listed, with a Romanesque crypt holding a 4th-century white-marble sarcophagus.

sources.title: Ville d'Aire-sur-l'Adour · Sainte-Quitterie
sources.claim: Sainte-Quitterie was the first monument classified in the Landes (1840); crypt restored 2018.

sources.title: OT Aire-Eugénie · Sainte-Quitterie
sources.claim: Free 45-minute guided visits Jul 1–Sep 14; off-season by appointment.

sources.title: ViaMichelin · Eugénie → Geaune
sources.claim: Geaune lies ~8 km / 9 minutes from Eugénie-les-Bains.

sources.title: Guide des Landes · Geaune
sources.claim: 1318 English bastide founded by Edward II's Genoese seneschal; 25-block grid, arcaded square.

sources.title: Landes Chalosse · Geaune & Tursan
sources.claim: Geaune is the seat of the Cave des Vignerons de Tursan.

sources.title: Bastides d'Aquitaine · Pimbo
sources.claim: Pimbo is the oldest bastide of the Landes, founded 1268.

sources.title: Tourisme Landes · Collégiale de Pimbo
sources.claim: Collégiale Saint-Barthélemy (foundation attributed to Charlemagne, 778), 12th-c. Romanesque, free.

sources.title: Distances Routières · Eugénie ↔ Pimbo
sources.claim: Pimbo is approximately 13 km from Eugénie-les-Bains.

sources.title: Tourisme Landes · Abbaye de Saint-Sever
sources.claim: Late 10th-c. Benedictine abbey, UNESCO Compostela, seven-staggered-apses choir, 77 capitals.

sources.title: Tourisme Landes · Salle du Trésor & Beatus
sources.claim: Cloister Treasure Room with Beatus facsimile, open through 31 Dec 2026.

sources.title: L'Itinéraire · Saint-Sever ↔ Eugénie
sources.claim: Saint-Sever is about 26 km / 29 minutes from Eugénie-les-Bains.

sources.title: Ville de Hagetmau · Crypte Saint-Girons
sources.claim: 12th-c. crypt of Saint-Girons, four marble columns, 14 historiated capitals (Monument Historique).

sources.title: Landes Chalosse · Crypte Saint-Girons
sources.claim: Compostela stop; descent by two lateral wall-staircases; pamphlets in four languages.

sources.title: Tourisme Landes · Bastide de Grenade-sur-l'Adour
sources.claim: 1322 bastide with arcaded central square and 14th–15th-c. houses.

sources.title: Routard · Grenade-sur-l'Adour
sources.claim: 15th-c. Gothic Saint-Pierre-et-Saint-Paul gained its twin-tower façade in 1833.

sources.title: L'Itinéraire · Eugénie → Grenade
sources.claim: Grenade is ~14 km / 16 minutes north of Eugénie-les-Bains.

sources.title: OT Landes d'Armagnac · Labastide-d'Armagnac
sources.claim: Founded 1291; Place Royale reputedly inspired Henri IV's Place des Vosges.

sources.title: Wikipédia · Chapelle Notre-Dame-des-Cyclistes
sources.claim: National sanctuary of cycling (1959); 700+ donated champion jerseys.

sources.title: CalculerDistance · Eugénie ↔ Labastide
sources.claim: Labastide-d'Armagnac is ~43 km / 47 minutes from Eugénie-les-Bains.

sources.title: Les Prés d'Eugénie · Château de Bachen
sources.claim: Guérards' own vineyard since 1983; by appointment Mon–Fri 10:00 / 15:00.

sources.title: OT Aire-Eugénie · Cave de Tursan
sources.claim: Tuesday guided cellar tour + 5-wine tasting, €5/person.

sources.title: Cave des Vignerons de Tursan
sources.claim: 1958 cooperative, ~60 growers / 500 ha; bottles €4.60–€7.65.

sources.title: Verymap · Geaune ↔ Eugénie
sources.claim: Geaune is 6.2 km as the crow flies / 7.7 km road from Eugénie.

sources.title: Landes Chalosse · Vignoble Dulucq
sources.claim: Family Tursan estate at Payros-Cazautets; free tasting year-round by appointment.

sources.title: Château Garreau · Visite-Dégustation
sources.claim: Écomusée de l'Armagnac on 82 ha — 17th-c. Vigneron museum, 10+ alembics, underground cellar.

sources.title: OT Landes d'Armagnac · Écomusée
sources.claim: Vigneron visit €6, Prince visit €12, family €14; Œnotourism Trophy 2025.

sources.title: Landes Chalosse · Domaine d'Ognoas
sources.claim: Tastings €2–€5 (Floc + Bas-Armagnac); 1804 still (Monument Historique).

sources.title: Domaine d'Ognoas
sources.claim: 565 ha estate, 7 centuries of history; oldest functioning still in Gascogne (1804).

sources.title: ViaOuest · Eugénie ↔ Arthez-d'Armagnac
sources.claim: Arthez-d'Armagnac is 24 km from Eugénie-les-Bains.

sources.title: OT Aire-Eugénie · Marché
sources.claim: Aire weekly market Tue + Sat, 8:00–12:30, ~50 vendors in Les Halles.

sources.title: Guide des Landes · Marché Saint-Sever
sources.claim: Saturday morning market with foie gras, duck, poultry, cheeses, pork, honey.

sources.title: Tourisme Landes · Marchés au Gras
sources.claim: Oct–Apr fat markets at Amou, Geaune, Hagetmau, Saint-Sever — duck farms open to visitors.

sources.title: Ville de Hagetmau · Marchés
sources.claim: Wed + Sat market 8h–13h, Place Charles De Gaulle; summer Marché des Producteurs.

sources.title: OT Pays Grenadois · Marchés
sources.claim: Grenade producer markets Mon / Wed / Sat 9–12; Sat adds takeaway food.

sources.title: Guide des Landes · Maison Dubernet
sources.claim: Founded 1864 in Saint-Sever; factory shop with first-Friday open-house (15–20% off).

sources.title: Maison Lafitte · Montaut
sources.claim: Boutique-production site, Mon–Fri 8h–17h, sources from ~80 Landes farms within 40 km.

sources.title: ICI · Maison Lafitte reportage
sources.claim: 100% Label Rouge + IGP Sud-Ouest; Mulards raised ≥102 days outdoors, fattened on whole grain corn.

sources.title: Ferme Parlariou
sources.claim: Gamarde-les-Bains; afternoon farm visits by appointment; foie gras, confit + Blonde d'Aquitaine.

sources.title: Tourisme Landes · Ferme Parlariou
sources.claim: Tours €6 adult / €3 child (5–15), free tasting at the end.

sources.title: Landes Chalosse · Tursan vineyards & potteries
sources.claim: Geaune's cooperative cellars welcome visitors April–October.

sources.title: Landes · Musée de la Faïence de Samadet
sources.claim: Royal 1732 manufactory legacy; 300+ pieces; Maison de la Céramique alongside.

sources.title: Tourisme Landes · En Direct de nos Producteurs
sources.claim: Saint-Sever shop aggregating Sarrade / Delpeyrat partners with full traceability.

sources.title: IGP Canard à Foie Gras du Sud-Ouest
sources.claim: IGP guarantees raised, fattened and cooked inside Chalosse/Gascogne/Gers/Landes/Périgord/Quercy.

sources.title: OT Aire-Eugénie · Randonnée
sources.claim: Three signposted loops from Eugénie: Blue 3.3 km, Green 6.6 km, Red 7.2 km.

sources.title: OT Aire-Eugénie · Étape pèlerin
sources.claim: Aire is a GR65 / Via Podiensis stage; 26 km from Nogaro, 17 km to Miramont-Sensacq.

sources.title: Scandibérique (EuroVelo 3)
sources.claim: 1,776 km cycling route Maubeuge → Roncevaux, inaugurated 2018.

sources.title: EuroVelo 3 · Mont-de-Marsan → Saint-Sever
sources.claim: Marked Scandibérique runs Mont-de-Marsan → Dax; Saint-Sever via a CycloTransEurope variant.

sources.title: Landes Chalosse · Voie Verte de la Chalosse
sources.claim: 34 km greenway on the old Saint-Sever–Dax railway via Montfort, Montaut, Mugron.

sources.title: AF3V · Voie Verte de la Chalosse
sources.claim: Surface stabilised gravel, unsuited to road bikes; central Hauriet section closes in pigeon season.

sources.title: Canoë Kayak Aturin
sources.claim: Kayak €15/half-day, double canoe €30, SUP €10/h; June–early September on the Adour.

sources.title: Landes Holidays · Canoë Aturin
sources.claim: Daily July–August (by appointment otherwise); 7 km / 2.5 h loop; must know how to swim.

sources.title: LeCoinGolf · Golf du Tursan
sources.claim: 9 holes, par 35, 2,786 m, slope 133/126; designed by Jean Larrouy in 1996.

sources.title: OT Aire-Eugénie · Les Greens d'Eugénie
sources.claim: Open daily 9:00–18:30 year-round; 12-station practice, putting green, clubhouse.

sources.title: OT Aire-Eugénie · Domaine de Benquet
sources.claim: Equestrian centre at Le Houga (8 km past Aire); pony baptisms from age 3, trail rides, vaulting.

sources.title: Chemins de Compostelle · Abbaye Saint-Sever
sources.claim: One of 78 components of UNESCO 'Chemins de Compostelle en France' on Voie de Vézelay.

sources.title: Landes Chalosse · Abbaye-église
sources.claim: Free admission; standard guided tour €3–€5 or tablet from Tourist Office.

sources.title: Wikipedia · Saint-Sever Beatus
sources.claim: Only illustrated Beatus produced north of the Pyrenees; inspired Picasso's Guernica.

sources.title: Tourisme Landes · Musée Samadet
sources.claim: 3 permanent rooms + temporary; faïence demos 2nd Sunday of each month 15:30–16:30.

sources.title: Notre-Dame des Cyclistes
sources.claim: National sanctuary of cycling; jerseys of Poulidor, Merckx, Ocaña, Virenque, Jeannie Longo.

sources.title: Wikipédia · Collégiale Saint-Barthélemy de Pimbo
sources.claim: 12th-c. three-naved Romanesque; classified Monument Historique 1998.

sources.title: Musée d'art et d'histoire du Cap de Gascogne
sources.claim: Jacobins convent museum: €4 / €3, free under-10; Gleyzia villa + Beatus interpretive spaces.

sources.title: Tourisme Landes · Crypte Saint-Girons
sources.claim: Open mid-June to mid-September 14:30–18:30, closed Sundays; €3–4 (free under 10).

sources.title: OT Aire-Eugénie · Venir chez nous
sources.claim: Aire ~15 km, Grenade ~15 km, Mont-de-Marsan 26 km, Pau 58 km; A65 fastest into Aire.

sources.title: PlanDeRoute · Aire → Eugénie
sources.claim: Aire-sur-l'Adour to Eugénie is 13.5 km / 17 minutes.

sources.title: L'Itinéraire · Hagetmau ↔ Eugénie
sources.claim: Hagetmau to Eugénie is 25.5 km / 34 minutes.

sources.title: CalculerDistance · Hagetmau ↔ Samadet
sources.claim: Hagetmau–Samadet is ~10 km / 11 min.

sources.title: PlanDeRoute · Pau → Eugénie
sources.claim: Pau to Eugénie is ~68.9 km / 55 minutes.

sources.title: OT Landes d'Armagnac · Notre-Dame Cyclistes
sources.claim: Open 1 May–15 Oct, Tue–Sun 15h–18h (closed Mondays).

sources.title: Écomusée de l'Armagnac
sources.claim: Vigneron museum, still museum, botanical trail, ponds + on-site escape game by reservation.

sources.title: Crypte Saint-Girons (site officiel)
sources.claim: Outside the mid-Jun–mid-Sep window, only by Tourism Office appointment.

sources.title: Guide des Landes · Pimbo
sources.claim: Oldest bastide of the Landes (1268); open village, no ticketed hours — Sunday/Monday safe.

sources.title: Château de Pau · Infos pratiques
sources.claim: Open daily 9h30–11h45 / 14h–17h; no Monday closure (closed 25 Dec, 1 Jan, 1 May).

sources.title: Campings Landes · Top 10 fermes
sources.claim: Aire mini-farm with ~70 animals; La Forge animée at Castelnau-Tursan.
